incidents.name: XDK sell path moves XDK out of its own pair
incidents.notes: XDK's sell path transfers XDK directly out of its Pancake pair and syncs it, so the attacker flash-borrowed GPC, bought XDK in 10% reserve chunks and repeatedly triggered the recycle path before selling back.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x02739be625f7a1cb196f42dceee630c394dd9faa created 2025-11-12T02:01:23Z by 0x85dfe8fac750d08393dc02df35e3b2d5bfc0c667, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xb180ef1bf6fb3e9a0b5db4460e4db804e946cc8a; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). 6.84 WBNB x $626.388779/BNB at the incident timestamp 1771246283 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $4,285.
